ABOUT US

One hall. One team. One big night.

What is UMIXO?

UMIXO is the annual gathering where the HighRadius community comes together in one room. It is part celebration, part town hall: live performances, ideas from the leadership stage and time to connect with colleagues from across teams.

Every edition is designed to make the whole team feel seen, from the dancers on stage to the people in the last row. UMIXO 2026 is the next chapter.
